# Independent build-14 source review

Subject main e1848d4e3a04b31cbb616f16b77d80525f6a7a5c. Risk-weighted source exclusion only, not runtime, dependency, security, advisory or G11 clearance. No builds, browser tests, packed-artifact tests or 21.x validation executed by this reviewer.

Independently re-counted and hash-checked fourteen original patch files against the hunk inventory: 1,020 file sections and 2,323 hunks; no count or patch hash mismatch. Independently checked b5 lock-hunk pair multisets: 1,973 resolution pairs agree after removal solely of tarball fields; remaining changes include compiler-cli patch identities and removal of one deprecation line, which must not be described as tarball-only. This is risk-weighted graph-boundary review, not a claim that all hunks were individually examined by this reviewer.

Current root build invokes scripts/pack-library.mjs -> pinned pnpm exec ng-packagr with project ng-package and tsconfig -> npm pack; historical tests use selected local specs, esbuild and Karma; project configuration includes own source and assets, not upstream src/dev-app, docs or Bazel rules. Main has compiler-cli 22.1.7, ng-packagr 22.1.1, Jasmine 5.6.0 and no root pnpm patchedDependencies. Matching package names do not establish unchanged installed source. Actual installed compiler, dependencies, npm tooling and runtime behavior need their own evidence. e184 adds a public-peer Sass focus companion call and separate test/proof, without importing the reviewed upstream graph; this review does not assess peer focus semantics.

Individual original SHA judgments (source exclusion only):

- ff4f9a093715b9552f2c2dfa1cb69656c70db182: upstream BUILD platform-browser-dynamic labels, including reordering. Own dependency remains; no removal or runtime conclusion.
- 8c35b62f65ed6cb9f56d9ad32ca558bb482c1e12: upstream Bazel testing-target migration, remote C++ config and strict-deps interop; no maintained Bazel test execution.
- 1c223d9ebff38a9fca38af554b601f121df7d99e: Bazel rules migration and universal/test tsconfigs; own explicit tsconfig and independent test runner.
- d2e154c60cc124b882d0afd26256034bd3e22489: Bazel migration, symlink prefix and linker mapping; actual ng-packagr/linker remains separately material.
- b5d4de9794cd6c826a9a2d4fb27e7e9e3cb884ac: ng_project graph, compiler-cli 20 next patch changes rootDir/rootDirs LogicalProjectStrategy, lock and acquisition settings. Current 22.1.7 is independently specified and not configured with this patch; no claim of same compiler semantics or security.
- ae9678df4b22be90ae27cec25224e364e91963f5: ng_project migration plus non-Bazel example/localize and demo code; actual demo runtime side effect is excluded from maintained inputs, not a statement about own localization.
- 7af0f92fc5dd112933f096c18d3f1dfea4b8f052: upstream WORKSPACE, rule and Angular Bazel postinstall patches remove old ng_module and tsec references. Their exclusion does not waive own tests/security obligations.
- 5d27e7c0b454ef721b7a4dfdf99e18884f690378: Bazel interop rewiring and upstream highlight documentation generator module import change; own package and historical test runner do not select that generator. Current installed dependencies separately assessed.
- 207bc6cd48279538c58f6e275f5e758f940dee9e: upstream fine-grained targets, package/lock prelinking, experimental metadata, webdriver environment, esbuild configs and localize polyfill. These are distinct source inputs; no inference about same-named current packages.
- 6fa655c99756abcd7e7c80040cc72e4aa98a4df5: upstream Bazel test wrapper movement including generated style.innerHTML. No owned CSP or style safety conclusion.
- e500a8ea9ad5043dd2775b39e395204b5cbdb78b: Bazel defaults merge including npm substitutions/overwrite, strict dependencies and test wrappers. Those upstream macros are not current pack/test graph; own pack security remains separate.
- efea6041e057607efbfa4ec7caf0d2952150038f: BUILD animation labels removed, no product motion change. Engine-free behavior requires own tests.
- 5373ced467ba58315abf22bc96c0c24583467776: Bazel strict-deps and experimental accordion import spelling; no owned accordion or experimental peer source. No inference of own dependency strictness.
- d67ac1f67efab6460f7a9544cb423aac5d6cd325: Jasmine 6, docs runner and transitive lock changes; independently pinned current Jasmine and transitive dependencies require separate advisory assessment.
